messages:
maria.partnerships: Heads up — ACME Cloud's marketplace listing just went live with the wrong SKU multiplier. Their entry shows a '3x' capacity factor for the ded. GPU SKU, which caused their reservations to double-book a chunk of our EU-west2 Dedicated pool. Notified infra but wanted to flag here since this intersects partner credits + customer commits. :warning:
ryan.ops: On it. Pinged ACME partner rep via email and their partner portal. Asking them to revert the listing and publish a corrected manifest. If they don't within the hour we should pause new allocations to the partner.
oliver.logistics: We have two staging racks in FRA ready to ship. If we need to reduce tenant impact we can reassign those to EU-west2 for the short term. That would require a commit adjustment and a 6-8 hour lead to finish the handoff.
jenna.sales: We have two enterprise customers on the queue that were promised capacity by EOD tomorrow. If we pull staging racks we'll need to notify them and adjust credits. Who owns the comms to customers?
alex.eng: We can also quick-block new partner reservations with the control-plane. Command (ops-only):
```
redwoodctl allocations pause --partner acme-cloud --region eu-west2 --reason "marketplace-sku-mismatch"
```
If someone with perms runs that it will stop further double-booking while partner corrects listing.
maria.partnerships: @ryan.ops please run that if ACME doesn't confirm in 30m. @jenna.sales I can draft a short customer note (holding language + credit offer).
ryan.ops: I contacted ACME and they replied — they think it's a UI multiplier bug on their side and are pushing a corrected manifest. Asked for ETA 25m. I'll run the pause if no update at +30.
deploy-bot: allocation-action: pause request queued by ryan.ops; pending approval.
oliver.logistics: If pause goes through we should still plan the rack swap as contingency. I'll prep the shipping manifest and rack config so it's plug-and-play.
jenna.sales: Please include max credit numbers in the draft so I can prep the account teams. Customers want a firm SLA workaround.
alex.eng: FYI engineering saw a small spike in allocation API errors after the double-booking started — nothing blocked, but we should monitor tokenized routing for retries. Added a trace for partner->allocation flow.
maria.partnerships: Action list: 1) @ryan.ops wait 30m then pause allocations if no partner fix. 2) @oliver.logistics prep rack swap manifest. 3) @jenna.sales hold comms draft review — I'll send copy in 15m. 4) @alex.eng keep the trace/alerts on. I'll escalate to partnerships lead if ACME doesn't publish fix in 45m.
ryan.ops: Affirmative. I'll update this thread after the pause or partner update.
maria.partnerships: Thanks — keeping channel updated. :white_check_mark:
